name: dsh-collaboration-access

mvpHttps.transport: Bounded NDJSON JSON-RPC over HTTPS/WSS /collaboration/socket; server loopback backend only
mvpHttps.initialize: No connector ticket or account before initialize; exact extension v3 plus serviceId and agentCapabilities.mvpHttps=true required; no SSH fallback
mvpHttps.loginStart: Original deviceId and 256-bit proof; returns 5-minute requestId/loginUrl/openUrl/pairingCode/expiresAt. No preallocated account
mvpHttps.pcPage: Official in-client requestAuthCode, verify scoped active internal identity, display actual name/corp/service then explicit human confirmation; browser-bound cookie and original-device claim proof
mvpHttps.claim: Only original device/proof receives one-use token and server-derived account/name/administrator; never browser token storage
mvpHttps.loginLimits: Maximum fixed 7 days, organization cache at most 5 minutes; temporary unavailable is -32014 pause with token retained; official denied revokes
mvpHttps.clientPersistence: Windows CurrentUser DPAPI only; no plaintext token in config, SQLite, URLs, browser or logs
mvpHttps.projectAccess: All active members see all projects/shared content; private conversation and immutable project/object/role checks remain
mvpHttps.administration: collaboration/admin view/create/role only; fixed administrator, commandId dedupe, monotonic role revision; no member lifecycle, project ACL or device-management API
mvpHttps.communication: Disabled; DingTalk identity only, no bot or IM business lifecycle
mvpHttps.legacyBelow: The remaining v3 fields document the historical SSH/OAuth mode only, never fallback from MVP mode

webQrMvp.initialize: clientCapabilities.webQrLogin=1 plus exact v3; agentCapabilities.mvpHttps=true,mvpHttpsVersion=2,loginMethod=dingtalk-qr. PC clients fail closed
webQrMvp.start: Explicit original deviceId/proof creates one 5-minute request; returns requestId/loginUrl/openUrl/loginMethod/expiresAt, no account or pairing code. Same proof start is idempotent only within original TTL
webQrMvp.resume: collaboration/login/resume {deviceId,proof} queries original request only; never creates a replacement request or opens browser
webQrMvp.browser: Same-origin POST /collaboration/qr/bind with fragment capability, JSON custom header and HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax cookie; official hosted OAuth page only. Callback uses state and cookie; official active internal member auto-enrolls actual identity, no second app confirmation
webQrMvp.claim: Original {requestId,deviceId,proof}; repeat response-loss claim recovers same token/expiry during original TTL until explicit ack. HMAC token derives under original proof, never stored server-side; browser capability cannot derive it
webQrMvp.cancel: collaboration/login/cancel {requestId,deviceId,proof}; cancelled blocks late callback/claim, completed reports an already-issued login instead of false cancellation
webQrMvp.ack: collaboration/login/ack after durable DPAPI save disables short-lived claim response recovery; never changes 7-day login
webQrMvp.persistence: Same service/origin mapping and Windows DPAPI file; pending proof/cancel intent also encrypted for restart, no plaintext fallback. Server stores only token/proof/browser-capability hashes
webQrMvp.cutover: Explicit stopped maintenance only: same member/service/project/session epoch/revisions, revoke prior PC device credentials and pending requests once; new QR startup refuses unupgraded PC mode. No reset or SSH/PC runtime fallback
webQrMvp.network: Existing LAN/ZeroTier computer HTTPS boundary; phone ordinary Internet official authorization only, real path verification required; no new public ingress

transport: Bounded JSON-RPC NDJSON over member-owned strict SSH and server-local socket
compatibility: Exact collaborationProtocolVersion 3; no downgrade to SSH-only business access
transportIdentity: collaboration/connect is connector-only; verified SSH account is not sufficient business authorization

login.initialize: authMethods includes dingtalk-device; client verifies trusted loginOrigin
login.browser: Server-owned HTTPS OAuth page/callback; bound browser cookie, state and one-use authorization code; no service token in browser
login.claimResult: pending or one-use authenticated result including service login token; only original SSH account/device can claim
login.collaboration/login/logout: Revoke current connection login or explicit matching token/deviceId on same SSH account after disconnect; not global member qualification
login.limits: Device maximum 12 hours, organization verification maximum 5 minutes; expired verification fails closed
login.tokenStorage: Client local Host memory only; server stores token hash, no chat/browser storage

projectScopes.scope: Immutable account/project/channel context, recorded participation revision and test epoch
projectScopes.session/load: Same owner and valid scope only; qualification changes cannot revive old model context
projectScopes.session/resume: Same validation as load; never replays prompts
projectScopes.session/list: Account-owned entries with projectId; legacy unscoped entries remain history-only
projectScopes.collaboration/history: Owner and device authenticated; scoped history rechecks project qualification; legacy unscoped history is read-only
projectScopes.tools: Project ID plus all related object ownership checked; source-specific allowlist enforced server-side

requests.deduplication: Stable request ID; attempted submissions never automatically replay
requests.session/cancel: Only current owned active session, committed facts remain

communications.visibility: Enabled project participant only; private requests limited to sender/recipient; all group audience members verified before each send
communications.replyDestination: Original request records exact reply target and revision; changed/missing target means recorded-not-sent, never alternate delivery
communications.reliability: Durable inbox before ACK; durable intent and per-part state; unknown/partial never blindly replayed
communications.receipts: processQueryKey is provider correlation only, not message ID/delivery/read; explicit receipt is not formal agreement
communications.bodyRetention: Explicit administrator purge of expired database bodies; model transcript policy pending human confirmation

attachmentExtension.scope: Current human account/session/request handle, authenticated conversation project must match
attachmentExtension.reverseMethod: collaboration/attachment/read; no filesystem, terminal or other reverse methods
attachmentExtension.limits: 5 files, 20MiB per message, 49152 byte chunks; existing integrity and human archive permission rules remain
attachmentExtension.availability: DSH entry only; no IM file capability
